limits: Custom metadata edges are heuristic on the outbound side: a record field value naming a class is read as a dispatch target, which can over-claim (a value that coincidentally matches a class name) and under-claim (indirection the reading cannot follow).

Handlers are classes named by record field values; the dispatches observed through Type.forName come from the last coverage run, attributed through the classes that query this type — a dispatch on a path that run did not execute is not here, and one recorded before the code changed may no longer happen.

Queriers are the classes reading this type in Apex; anything reaching those classes appears as a transitive dependent, not as a querier. A query built as a string and run through Database.query is not read.
